description.value: A longitudinal voxel-based morphometry study comparing gray matter volume in methamphetamine users and drug-naïve controls during abstinence, including group, longitudinal, and drug-use regression analyses.

spans.text: The present study suggested that heavy MA users' GMV could show dynamic alterations in different brain regions at different time lengths of abstinence.
